intent: Keep the two-lane calendar beside its report and chapter sources. The combined view supports comparison while preserving which source supplies each lane.
source:
**Frame:** The two-lane calendar, complete, with the four-authors' report and the book's own chapter titles side by side at the right edge.

**Screen / system text — CHATGPT:**
> The book was not wrong about the sequence it told. It was wrong to let the sequence look like a census.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` + `inferred` — dramatized creator exchange; the correction is to the book's framing, per the [population model](../story-contract.md), not to any documented event.
title: The two-lane calendar sits beside its sources
